items.title: 10.9 Electrolysis ke doran banne wale madde ki miqdar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.9 with Sample 10.5, printed page 222.

blocks.text: F ki qeemat electrode par jama madde ki mass aur electrode par banne wali gas ka hajm nikalne mein istemal hoti hai.
Sample Problem 10.5: pighle lead(II) bromide se lead

Jab 1.50 A ka current pighle PbBr2 se 20.0 min guzre to cathode par jama lead ki mass nikalein (Pb ka Ar 207; F = 96500 C mol-1). Qadam 1, half-equation: Pb2+ + 2e- se Pb. Qadam 2, fi mole product coulombs: fi mole Pb 2 moles electrons = 2F = 2 x 96500 = 193000 C mol-1. Qadam 3, guzra charge: Q = I x t = 1.50 x 20 x 60 = 1800 C. Qadam 4, tanasub se mass: 193000 C 1 mole, 207 g, jama karta hai, to 1800 C 1800 / 193000 x 207 = 1.93 g lead jama karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Silver nitrate solution 0.18 A par 35 min electrolyse hota hai. Jama silver ki mass nikalein (Ar 108). Phir: dilute sulfuric acid se 6.00 min tak 1.04 A STP par 41.5 cm3 hydrogen deta hai; kitne coulombs guzre, aur 1 mole H2 ke liye kitne chahiye (Quick Check 10.5)?
blocks.explanation: Silver: Q = 0.18 x 35 x 60 = 378 C; Ag+ ko 1 F chahiye, to mass = 378 / 96500 x 108 = 0.42 g. Hydrogen: Q = 1.04 x 360 = 374 C. STP par 41.5 cm3 41.5 / 22400 = 1.85 x 10^-3 mol hai, to 1 mole ko 374 / 1.85 x 10^-3 = 2.0 x 10^5 C chahiye, taqreeban 2F, jaisa 2H+ + 2e- se H2 mangta hai.

items: F se mass ya gas ka hajm: half-equation, fi mole charge (nF), guzra charge (It), tanasub. Sample 10.5: PbBr2 mein 20 min 1.50 A 1800 C aur 1.93 g Pb deta hai.
